description: This Java class JmsBasedRegistrationClient implements a client for device registration over JMS, extending request-response capabilities and providing methods for asserting registration and sending custom requests.

classes.name: JmsBasedRegistrationClient
classes.description: A Java client class for registering devices via JMS, supporting registration assertions and custom request messaging.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new client instance with connection, configuration, and tenant info.

methods.name: assertRegistration
methods.description: Method to assert registration for a device, optionally with a gateway ID.

methods.name: sendRequest
methods.description: Sends a custom JMS request message with specified operation, properties, and payload, and processes the response.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Processes the response payload and status code into a RegistrationResult object.
